name: Feminist Center for Creative Work
about_text: The Feminist Center for Creative Work is a non-profit arts and community organization in Los Angeles centered on feminist creative practices. It runs an ongoing program of exhibitions, artist residencies, workshops, and publications intended to foster an intersectional feminist future. Recent programming includes group exhibitions such as Radical Kinship, curated by Chloë Flores, and artist-in-residence projects such as K. Bradford's Wild Glitch. The organization connects visitors to events, groups, and creative work through its website and space, though specific founding details and staff leadership are not stated on the available pages.
